candidates.name: Gas pipeline branch to GRS KRP-21 (Chekhov / Peshkovo, Moscow Oblast)
candidates.sponsor: Gazprom transgaz Moskva (customer Gazprom Invest / Gazprom Reconstruction; designer Gazprom promgaz)
candidates.from: unknown (existing Gazprom trunk system, Moscow Oblast)
candidates.to: KRP-21, Chekhov city district near Peshkovo

evidence.note: New pipeline 'more than 100 km', 220 thousand m3/h, completion 2026, Gazprom transgaz Moskva as customer.

KRP-21 in Chekhov district near Peshkovo, March 2025 - October 2026, 300 thousand m3/h; describes a pressure-reduction station with a connecting pipeline for New Moscow supply (pipeline length not stated; the two sources differ on capacity and the >100 km figure is unconfirmed).
Lists KRP-21 in the 2026-2030 Gazprom transgaz Moskva plan (KRP upgrades incl. conversion of several GRS to GRP).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for KRP-21; nearest roster context is Ring of Moscow region P2380. OSM seeds name KRP-11/13/15/16 spurs (Voskresensk-KRP-11/16, KRP-13, KRP-15), so the KRP-21 route may be one of those or a different line - length (>100 km) is a single-source claim, endpoints unknown. Consolidator should check against the OSM KRP seeds and P2321 (Kasimovskoye UGS-Voskresensk) before treating as new.

candidates.name: Starodub gas pipeline branch, second line (Bryansk Oblast)
aka: вторая нитка газопровода-отвода к ГРС Стародуб
candidates.from: unknown (existing branch / trunk in Pogar district)

evidence.note: Second line of the pipeline branch to GRS Starodub completed in 2025: more than 46 km laid, 13 valve sites, in Pogarsky and Starodubsky districts; design under way for a second stage Starodub - GRS Novozybkov (length not given).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row for a Starodub branch (nearest Bryansk rows P2288 Bryansk-Smolensk, P2387 Shebelinka-Belgorod-Kursk-Bryansk). Source says 44 km of DN500 welded (46 km total). A planned stage-2 Starodub-Novozybkov branch (proposed, length unknown) is a separate possible row.

candidates.name: Shebelinka-Belgorod-Kursk-Bryansk gas pipeline, Belgorod bypass (relocation outside city)
aka: вынос МГ ШБКБ за пределы Белгорода

evidence.note: 44.3 km bypass section, DN1200, 5.4 MPa, ~6.7 bn RUB incl. new GRS-1A; scheduled 2020.
States the ShBKB main pipeline in Belgorod Oblast was reconstructed with the high-pressure pipeline moved outside Belgorod (completed in 2021-2025 period).

candidates.why_maybe_new: Possible match to P2387 (parent ShBKB, 507 km, DN1020) - the bypass is a rerouted DN1200 segment, so it is a borderline new-segment/replacement candidate; consolidator decides whether it is its own row or a note on P2387.

candidates.name: Solikamsk - Gubdor - Cherdyn inter-settlement gas pipeline (northern Perm Krai)
aka: Межпоселковый газопровод ГРС Соликамск - Губдор - Березовая Старица - Рябинино - Сергово - Чердынь
North Perm Krai gasification pipeline stage 1
candidates.sponsor: Gazprom Mezhregiongaz (built via Gazprom gazoraspredelenie Perm)

evidence.note: Gas pipeline of 'more than 100 km' from GRS Solikamsk serving Gubdor, Seregovo, Berezovaya Starica, Ryabinino and Cherdyn; part of Gazprom 2021-2025 Perm Krai programme.

Three-stage northern gasification plan: stage 1 Solikamsk-Gubdor-Berezovaya Starica-Ryabinino-Seregovo-Cherdyn; stage 2 Cherdyn-Pokcha-...-Nyrob; stage 3 Gubdor-Nizhnyaya Yazva-Krasnovishersk (stage lengths not given here).
New 2026-2030 Perm Krai Gazprom programme (context for stages 2-3).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Perm Krai Solikamsk/Cherdyn/Krasnovishersk row in roster. Length 104.5 km per Gazprom Mezhregiongaz/Perm Krai release (found via search, those two sites unreachable from here so not cited); stages 2 and 3 (Cherdyn-Nyrob, Gubdor-Krasnovishersk) are separate possible rows, length unknown. Seed leads 'Chusovoy-Berezniki-Solikamsk 1/2' are a different line.

candidates.name: Urensky district GRS (Obkhod) - Shakhunya inter-settlement gas pipeline (Nizhny Novgorod Oblast)
candidates.sponsor: Gazprom / Gazprom Mezhregiongaz Nizhny Novgorod (regional gasification programme)
candidates.from: GRS near Obkhod village, Urensky municipal district

evidence.note: 30.6 km pipeline completed, gas arrived 23 Sept 2026; opens six northern districts (Sharanga, Tonkino, Tonshaevo, Vetluga, Varnavino later phases through 2030).
Governor reported completion of the 30.6 km inter-settlement pipeline to the President.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Urensky/Shakhunya row in roster; same class (regional gasification trunk, >=25 km) as GEM rows P3973/P3974. Follow-on phases to Sharanga, Tonkino, Tonshaevo, Vetluga, Varnavino are further possible rows (lengths unknown).

candidates.name: GRS-3 Rybinsk - Chernaya Rechka - Okhotino gas pipeline (Yaroslavl Oblast)
aka: ГРС-3 Рыбинск - сан. Черная речка - с. Охотино

evidence.note: Construction started Aug 2021 on 42.5 km pipeline in Rybinsky and Myshkinsky districts under the 2021-2025 programme (current status not confirmed).

candidates.why_maybe_new: No Rybinsk-Okhotino row in roster (Yaroslavl rows: P2372 Pochinki-Yaroslavl only). Status and completion date unconfirmed - needs vetting.

candidates.name: Gavrilov-Posad district inter-settlement gas pipeline to Yardenikha (Ivanovo Oblast)

evidence.note: 40.3 km pipeline linking settlements including Zakomelie, Yarshevo, Zagorodniy, Novoselka, Glumovo, Vladychino, Skomorovo to Yardenikha; completion stated as 2022.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No matching Gavrilov-Posad row in roster. A 40.3 km chain of settlement links may be a mix of inter-settlement and in-settlement segments - needs vetting; the 35.8 km Yuryevets item in the same article reads as a town distribution network and is not emitted.
